subject: ela
intro: Infer from informational text and cite evidence.

items.prompt:
Read.

The lake's fish returned after the factory stopped dumping waste.

We can infer the dumping had:
A) helped the fish
B) harmed the fish
C) no effect

steps: Fish returned once it stopped. Key is B.

items.prompt:
An inference from a text is supported by:
A) a wild guess
B) textual evidence
C) the title

Strong analysis cites:
A) one detail only
B) several pieces of evidence
C) no evidence

Read.

The town's recycling rose to 65%, new bins appeared on every corner, and schools added recycling lessons.

Which inference is BEST supported?
A) The recycling program succeeded
B) The town ran out of bins
C) Students disliked recycling

steps: Several supporting facts. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The city added bike lanes, and bike commuting rose 40%.

We can infer the lanes:
A) discouraged biking
B) encouraged biking
C) had no effect

steps: Biking rose after lanes. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Why cite MORE than one fact?
A) to make the analysis more convincing
B) to fill space
C) to confuse readers
items.answer: A) to make the analysis more convincing

steps: Several facts build a case. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to make the analysis more convincing

items.prompt:
Read.

Despite record profits, the company laid off workers and cut safety spending.

The BEST supported inference is that the company:
A) was losing money
B) prioritized profit over workers' well-being
C) was very generous
items.answer: B) prioritized profit over workers' well-being

steps: Profits up, but cuts to people/safety. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) prioritized profit over workers' well-being

items.prompt:
Which choice uses SEVERAL pieces of evidence?
A) 'The reef is dying because the water is warm.'
B) 'The reef is dying: coral has bleached white, fish numbers have dropped, and water temperatures hit record highs.'
C) 'The reef seems unhealthy.'
items.answer: B) 'The reef is dying: coral has bleached white, fish numbers have dropped, and water temperatures hit record highs.'

solution.answer: B) 'The reef is dying: coral has bleached white, fish numbers have dropped, and water temperatures hit record highs.'
